action.label: Campaign
action.text: Target board's stock drops; next round its payout is pushed up one step.

scoring.rule: Scores on the target's payout rising the next round.

secret.text: You want a quick exit, not reform. Make at least one target raise its payout.

action.label: Story
action.text: Name a board and claim it left a fact out.

scoring.rule: Scores on stories that are true at the reveal.

secret.text: You need a story every round or you lose the beat.

action.label: Inspect
action.text: Each fact the board left out can be caught; heavier facts are easier to find.

secret.text: Your firm consults for one board, named on your card. Catching it costs your firm fees.

scoring.rule: Scores when the target's stock ends the round lower.

secret.text: A true tip to the Reporter makes your short pay. Leak at least once.

action.label: File
action.text: File a Dodge-style suit on a board with high wages or low payout, or a harm suit on a board caught hiding facts.

secret.text: You take a cut of any settlement. Get at least one suit settled.

false_hit_causes: inspect of a board that admitted every fact
credibility.low_effect: Next action's effect is halved, then credibility is reset to the threshold.

visits.rule: One Street member attends one board per round, announced in the app and on the projector. No member visits the same board twice.

executive_session.text: The board may vote to send the visitor out. Small stock hit, logged.

secret_scoring_note: Street secret pulls score a small bonus when met. Street members score on truth only, never on what a board does.
